FAQsWhat are the benefits of the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card?The Citi Simplicity® Credit Card offers cardmembers exceptional benefits that helps keep things simple, because we know there are much more important things in life. As a result, Citi Simplicity® Credit Card offers:
No late fees1
No penalty rate1
No annual fee — ever1
Other great benefits include: Merchant Offers, Flex Pay2, flexible payment due date, free access to your FICO® Score and $0 liability on unauthorized charges.
We weren't kidding when we said we like to keep things straightforward.
What are the fees associated with the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card?
Some of the key benefits of the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card are that it does not charge an annual fee1 and there are no late fees.1
However, cardholders may be charged other fees such as balance transfers, cash advances and foreign purchase transactions.1
Is the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card a Visa or Mastercard®?The Citi Simplicity® Credit Card is issued on the Mastercard® network, giving cardholders access to Mastercard benefits including Mastercard® ID Theft Protection. Additionally, the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card provides cardmembers with exceptional value through its low intro APR, no late fees, no penalty rate and no annual fee — ever.1Who is the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card best for?The Citi Simplicity® Credit Card may be a strong fit if you're looking to make purchases with a low intro APR and prefer a card without late fees, a penalty rate or an annual fee.1What credit score is recommended for a Citi Simplicity® Credit Card?Approval for the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card depends on several factors, not just credit score. However, it's generally recommended to have good to excellent credit when applying for the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card.Does the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card have a penalty APR?No, the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card does not have a penalty APR, even if a payment is missed.1Does Citi charge late fees on the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card?No, Citi does not charge late fees on the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card — it's one of the many great perks of being a Citi Simplicity® cardmember.1Does the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card have an annual fee?No, the Citi Simplicity® Credit Card does not have an annual fee — ever.1 It's one of the many ways we keep things straightforward.
